categories.main_business_segments: JSB operates primarily in the real estate rental management business, with a strong focus on student housing (student apartments and dormitories). The company also engages in related services such as property maintenance, tenant support, and property development. Other minor segments include student support services (such as job placement and event planning), Japanese language schools for international students, and limited real estate sales activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: JSB's core operational methods center on the planning, proposal, and management of student-focused rental properties, including original-design student apartments. The company utilizes a master lease model (bulk leasing with rent guarantees to property owners) and also offers property management services, maintenance, and tenant support. JSB emphasizes proprietary know-how in student housing operations, early identification of student needs, and digital transformation (DX) initiatives to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are students (domestic and international) seeking rental housing, as well as property owners (landlords) who entrust JSB with the management and leasing of their properties. Secondary customer groups include universities, vocational schools, corporations (for employee housing), and elderly individuals for specific rental properties. The company also serves educational institutions through partnerships and manages student dormitories on their behalf.
categories.geographic_coverage: JSB operates nationwide across Japan, with managed properties and direct offices in all major regions: Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto (Tokyo metropolitan area), Tokai/North Shinetsu, Kinki (Kyoto/Osaka), Hanshin, Chugoku/Shikoku, and Kyushu. As of April 2024, the company manages nearly 95,000 units in over 2,600 buildings and has 87 directly operated offices throughout the country.
categories.supply_chain_position: JSB is positioned downstream in the real estate value chain, acting as a property manager, master lessee, and service provider to end-users (tenants) and property owners. The company does not engage in upstream construction but collaborates with construction firms and architects for property development proposals and manages the leasing and operation of completed properties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: JSB's strategic focus is on expanding its market share in student housing, enhancing operational efficiency through business process reengineering (BPR), digital transformation (DX), and business process outsourcing (BPO). The company is investing in human capital, promoting diversity and employee engagement, and pursuing open innovation, alliances, and M&A for growth. Sustainability (ESG), climate change response (e.g., ZEH-compliant buildings), and the development of new business domains are also key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: JSB generates revenue primarily through rental income from master-leased properties, property management fees, tenant support services, and ancillary services such as maintenance and food services in student residences. Additional revenue streams include brokerage commissions from rental mediation, guarantee fees for rent liabilities, and limited real estate sales. The company also receives fees for student support and Japanese language school operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JSB is a leading player in the Japanese student housing management sector, with an estimated 5% market share of managed student apartments. Its main competitors include other large property management firms, real estate agencies, and housing manufacturers entering the student housing market. JSB differentiates itself through its nationwide network, proprietary student housing know-how, and strong partnerships with universities and student cooperatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending October 2024, JSB reported consolidated sales of approximately 69.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 8.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 7.45 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales increasing by 9% year-on-year and net profit up 56%. Total assets reached nearly 80 billion yen, and the company maintains a strong equity ratio (47.4%) and robust cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JSB emphasizes its unique value in providing safe, secure, and comfortable living environments tailored to students, leveraging proprietary operational expertise and early identification of student needs. The company differentiates itself through its original-design student apartments, comprehensive tenant support, high occupancy rates, and strong relationships with educational institutions. Its focus on sustainability, digital transformation, and customer experience further enhances its competitive edge.
